decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module draws directly on the firm's existing finishing and workflow knowledge, so its absorptive capacity is high and management would normally retain it as a complementary part of the portfolio.

The B2-format multifinisher is close to the firm's core capabilities and was presented as a strategic focus, so in a growing market management would be likely to continue backing and refining it rather than withdraw it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's established booklet-making and binding competence, which makes it comparatively easy to service, learn from, and improve commercially.
The folding add-on unit is tightly linked to the installed base and already had a visible customer application, so uncertainty is low and management would be inclined to keep it on the market.
